author: Arcani test fixtures
rationale: Theta and gamma fixture (Story 2.2): 10 s, for the stereo bus sum. Theta reference: 450 Hz carrier amplitude-modulated at 6 Hz by the sine envelope, 75 percent AM depth. Gamma PAC layer: 250 Hz sine carrier amplitude-modulated at 40 Hz with a constant 100 percent AM depth (uncoupled). Both the same in both channels; together they peak near 2.0, so the 24-bit WAV clips. Values are placeholders, not starter defaults. A test fixture, not for listening.
